notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The 'Election Results/Roster' page lists unofficial and official files per election and links the SOS site as 'TEXAS ELECTION NIGHT RESULTS'. 2024 general: '11.05.2024 Oldham County Unofficial Results' is a scanned Electionware Summary Results Report (county totals), scan created 9:01 PM CST Nov 5, Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 14:15:42 GMT (8:15 AM CST Nov 6); precinct numbers only in '11.05.2024 Oldham County - General Election Totals by Precinct' (OFFICIAL RESULTS, created Nov 22 2024, Last-Modified Mon, 10 Feb 2025). 2026 primary: '03.03.2026 JOINT PRIMARY ELECTION - UNOFFICIAL RESULTS' is a Summary Results Report with county totals (footer read as 'Election Summary - 03/03/2026 9:3x PM' at 45 dpi), scan created 9:46 PM CST, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 03:54:15 GMT (9:54 PM CST); precinct numbers only in '03.03.2026 Joint Primary Election Official Results - By Precinct'. 2026 runoff: 'Unofficial Totals Summary' and 'Unofficial Totals Precinct' scans were both created May 27 2026 13:58 to 14:00 UTC (8:58 to 9:00 AM CDT, the morning after), and both carry Last-Modified Thu, 30 Jul 2026 21:21:59 GMT (a later re-upload), so the runoff precinct numbers did not exist as this file until after election night. Confidence low: only the primary has both printed and upload times on election night.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (election-night or next-morning county totals; precinct numbers only after election night), so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS.
